# DunoLoons Axolotl
This datapack introduces a Axolotl-themed Hot Air Balloon to Minecraft, appearing over Cherry Grove biomes to add atmosphere and life to the sky.

## Installation
1. Download the datapack
2. Place it in your world folder: ```world/datapacks/```
3. Restart the world
4. Now explore your world and enjoy a livelier sky!

## Localization
To locate it using commands, run: ```/locate structure dunoloons_axolotl:balloon```

## Want more variety?
This pack is part of a series — each datapack introduces a unique balloon in a different biome!
Browse the full collection here: [Our Datapacks](https://modrinth.com/organization/duno)
